top_signals.title: Fed officials are already saying they’ll need to get back to hiking rates
top_signals.summary: Musalem's comments offer the first morsels of insight into what leaders at the Fed see next following this week's decision to hold interst rates steady.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
